scene.label: Act 2, Scene 2
scene.title: SCENE II. The same. A public way, or platform leading to the lists. A pavilion by the side of it for the reception of the King, Princess, Lords, etc.
scene.location: The same. A public way, or platform leading to the lists. A pavilion by the side of it for the reception of the King, Princess, Lords, etc.

content.text: Enter Simonides, Thaisa, Lords and Attendants.

lines.text: Are the knights ready to begin the triumph?
lines.plainText: Are the knights ready to begin the triumph

lines.text: They are, my liege;
lines.plainText: They are my liege

lines.text: And stay your coming to present themselves.
lines.plainText: And stay your coming to present themselves

lines.text: Return them, we are ready; and our daughter,
lines.plainText: Return them we are ready and our daughter

lines.text: In honour of whose birth these triumphs are,
lines.plainText: In honour of whose birth these triumphs are

lines.text: Sits here, like beauty's child, whom Nature gat
lines.plainText: Sits here like beauty's child whom Nature gat

lines.text: For men to see, and seeing wonder at.
lines.plainText: For men to see and seeing wonder at

lines.text: It pleaseth you, my royal father, to express
lines.plainText: It pleaseth you my royal father to express

lines.text: My commendations great, whose merit's less.
lines.plainText: My commendations great whose merit's less

lines.text: It's fit it should be so; for princes are
lines.plainText: It's fit it should be so for princes are

lines.text: A model, which heaven makes like to itself:
lines.plainText: A model which heaven makes like to itself

lines.text: As jewels lose their glory if neglected,
lines.plainText: As jewels lose their glory if neglected

lines.text: So princes their renowns if not respected.
lines.plainText: So princes their renowns if not respected

lines.text: 'Tis now your honour, daughter, to entertain
lines.plainText: 'Tis now your honour daughter to entertain

lines.text: The labour of each knight in his device.
lines.plainText: The labour of each knight in his device

lines.text: Which, to preserve mine honour, I'll perform.
lines.plainText: Which to preserve mine honour I'll perform

content.text: The first Knight passes by, and his Squire presents his shield to Thaisa.

lines.text: Who is the first that doth prefer himself?
lines.plainText: Who is the first that doth prefer himself

lines.text: A knight of Sparta, my renowned father;
lines.plainText: A knight of Sparta my renowned father

lines.text: And the device he bears upon his shield
lines.plainText: And the device he bears upon his shield

lines.text: Is a black Ethiope reaching at the sun:
lines.plainText: Is a black Ethiope reaching at the sun

lines.text: The word, Lux tua vita mihi.
lines.plainText: The word Lux tua vita mihi

lines.text: He loves you well that holds his life of you.
lines.plainText: He loves you well that holds his life of you

content.text: The second Knight passes by, and his Squire presents his shield to Thaisa.

lines.text: A prince of Macedon, my royal father;
lines.plainText: A prince of Macedon my royal father

lines.text: And the device he bears upon his shield
lines.plainText: And the device he bears upon his shield

lines.text: Is an arm'd knight that's conquer'd by a lady;
lines.plainText: Is an arm'd knight that's conquer'd by a lady

lines.text: The motto thus, in Spanish, Piu por dulzura que por forza.
lines.plainText: The motto thus in Spanish Piu por dulzura que por forza

content.text: The third Knight passes by, and his Squire presents his shield to Thaisa.

lines.text: And what's the third?
lines.plainText: And what's the third

lines.text: The third of Antioch;
lines.plainText: The third of Antioch

lines.text: And his device, a wreath of chivalry;
lines.plainText: And his device a wreath of chivalry

lines.text: The word, Me pompae provexit apex.
lines.plainText: The word Me pompae provexit apex

content.text: The fourth Knight passes by, and his Squire presents his shield to Thaisa.

lines.text: What is the fourth?
lines.plainText: What is the fourth

lines.text: A burning torch that's turned upside down;
lines.plainText: A burning torch that's turned upside down

lines.text: The word, Quod me alit me extinguit.
lines.plainText: The word Quod me alit me extinguit

lines.text: Which shows that beauty hath his power and will,
lines.plainText: Which shows that beauty hath his power and will

lines.text: Which can as well inflame as it can kill.
lines.plainText: Which can as well inflame as it can kill

content.text: The fifth Knight passes by, and his Squire presents his shield to Thaisa.

lines.text: The fifth, an hand environed with clouds,
lines.plainText: The fifth an hand environed with clouds

lines.text: Holding out gold that's by the touchstone tried;
lines.plainText: Holding out gold that's by the touchstone tried

lines.text: The motto thus, Sic spectanda fides.
lines.plainText: The motto thus Sic spectanda fides

content.text: The sixth Knight, Pericles, passes in rusty armour with bases, and unaccompanied. He presents his device directly to Thaisa.

lines.text: And what's the sixth and last, the which the knight himself
lines.plainText: And what's the sixth and last the which the knight himself

lines.text: With such a graceful courtesy deliver'd?
lines.plainText: With such a graceful courtesy deliver'd

lines.text: He seems to be a stranger; but his present is
lines.plainText: He seems to be a stranger but his present is

lines.text: A wither'd branch, that's only green at top;
lines.plainText: A wither'd branch that's only green at top

lines.text: The motto, In hac spe vivo.
lines.plainText: The motto In hac spe vivo

lines.text: A pretty moral;
lines.plainText: A pretty moral

lines.text: From the dejected state wherein he is,
lines.plainText: From the dejected state wherein he is

lines.text: He hopes by you his fortunes yet may flourish.
lines.plainText: He hopes by you his fortunes yet may flourish

lines.text: He had need mean better than his outward show
lines.plainText: He had need mean better than his outward show

lines.text: Can any way speak in his just commend;
lines.plainText: Can any way speak in his just commend

lines.text: For by his rusty outside he appears
lines.plainText: For by his rusty outside he appears

lines.text: To have practised more the whipstock than the lance.
lines.plainText: To have practised more the whipstock than the lance

lines.text: He well may be a stranger, for he comes
lines.plainText: He well may be a stranger for he comes

lines.text: To an honour'd triumph strangely furnished.
lines.plainText: To an honour'd triumph strangely furnished

lines.text: And on set purpose let his armour rust
lines.plainText: And on set purpose let his armour rust

lines.text: Until this day, to scour it in the dust.
lines.plainText: Until this day to scour it in the dust

lines.text: Opinion's but a fool, that makes us scan
lines.plainText: Opinion's but a fool that makes us scan

lines.text: The outward habit by the inward man.
lines.plainText: The outward habit by the inward man

lines.text: But stay, the knights are coming.
lines.plainText: But stay the knights are coming

lines.text: We will withdraw into the gallery.
lines.plainText: We will withdraw into the gallery

content.text: [Exeunt. Great shouts within, and all cry 'The mean Knight!']
